facts.P3_local_gateways: Local gateways not researched yet; see the services listed above.
facts.L1_registration: Register through the Ministry of Economic Development's Business Portal; steps not confirmed.
facts.L2_tax_id: TIN from MIRA, covering all taxes you're registered for.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Residents are taxed on worldwide income; 0% up to MVR 720,000.
facts.L4_vat_gst: GST 8% general, 16% tourism, above MVR 1 million; rates may have changed.
facts.L5_data_protection: No data protection law recorded in UNCTAD's tracker.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: No online consumer protection law recorded in UNCTAD's tracker.

watch_out.text: The Maldives taxes individuals since 2020, despite older guides saying otherwise.
